dataset_name: SMAP L4 surface and root-zone soil moisture
native_temporal_resolution: 3-hourly SMAP L4 product; script requests daily NASA POWER values
limitations: The Phase 2 script creates a geographically distributed pilot, not a complete archive for all 145,596 facilities.
A point request represents the source grid cell around the facility coordinate, not a field measurement at the facility.
Do not interpret soil moisture as groundwater availability.
Monthly means are calculated from available daily values; missing values are not zero.
SMAP L4 is a model-assimilation product using SMAP observations, not a direct in-situ measurement.
